text_block_list.text:
One day, while training with Rice Shower 
as usual—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm just so glad Miss Bourbon's injury 
healed. ...Because now we can keep running 
together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
She has made a full recovery now. I 
believe it's thanks to trying various 
treatments—including hot spring 
therapy—with a strong focus on fatigue 
recovery.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

Together with a flustered, teary-eyed Rice 
Shower, we hurried to check the expiration 
date on the Hot Springs Trip Voucher and 
set off for the inn—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Haah... That was a lovely bath... Rice is 
all soft and soggy now...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, look, look. My legs are all warm, 
and they feel way softer than usual~
choice_data_list:
The hot spring's effects are kicking in, 
huh.

The hot spring's effects are kicking in, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Right now, I feel like I could 
strrrrretch into any pose at all!

Rice Shower happily looked down at her 
legs.

—With those legs of hers, she has claimed 
victory in countless races so far.

I hope this hot spring can relieve at 
least a little bit of her built-up 
fatigue...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list:
I just want you to always stay healthy and 
happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list:
I just want you to always stay healthy and 
happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. With these legs of mine, Rice 
can run anywhere, no matter how far."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Because I've managed to run all this way. 
Through the Tenno Sho (Spring), the 
Takarazuka Kinen—"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Onii-sama. Which race should we pick 
next?
choice_data_list: Which race do you want to enter, Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Onee-sama. Which race should we go 
for next?
choice_data_list: Which race do you want to enter, Rice?

text_block_list.text:
And together with Rice Shower, we 
discussed our future ahead.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Rice Shower...
